mapper.select:
/* 로그 조회 쿼리 (selectLogLsit) */ SELECT A.AUDIT_ID as auditId , A.USER_ID as userId , C.EMP_KOR_FLNM as userNm , A.MENU_ID as menuId , B.MENU_NM AS menuNm , A.BTN_ID as btnId , A.ACTION_CD as actionCd , A.ACTION_NM as actionNm , A.REQ_URL as reqUrl , A.REQ_IP as reqIp , D.BR_NM as brNm , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FRST_REG_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as frstRegDttm FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A , ocuoc_menun_m B , OCUOC_USERI_M C , OCUOC_DPRMI_M D WHERE A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID AND A.USER_ID = C.EMPNO AND C.BLNG_BRCD = D.BR_CD
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
and (A.USER_ID LIKE '%'||#{userId}||'%' or C.EMP_KOR_FLNM LIKE '%'||#{userId}||'%')
and (D.BR_CD LIKE '%'||#{logBrCd}||'%' or D.BR_NM LIKE '%'||#{logBrCd}||'%')
ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

/* 로그 조회 페이징 총카운터 (selectLogCount) */ SELECT count(*) FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A , OCUOC_USERI_M C , OCUOC_DPRMI_M D WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = C.EMPNO AND C.BLNG_BRCD = D.BR_CD
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
and (A.USER_ID = #{userId} or C.EMP_KOR_FLNM LIKE '%'||#{userId}||'%')
and (D.BR_CD LIKE '%'||#{logBrCd}||'%' or D.BR_NM LIKE '%'||#{logBrCd}||'%')

/* 메뉴화면통계텝 메뉴별 접근 빈도 TOP5 (selectMenuTop5) */ SELECT MENU_NM as "menuNm" , CNT as "cnt" FROM ( SELECT M.MENU_NM,COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A INNER JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and (M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} OR M.UPRN_MENU_ID = #{menuId} )
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

/* 메뉴화면통계텝 화면별 버튼 클릭 분포 TOP5 (selectButtonTop5) */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MENU_NM AS "menuNm" , SUM(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CD IN ('SEARCH','LIST') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "searchCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CD IN ('SAVE','UPDATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "saveCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CD = 'DELETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "deleteCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CD = 'EXCEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "excelCnt" FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A INNER JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID WHERE A.BTN_ID IS NOT NULL
and (M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} OR M.UPRN_MENU_ID = #{menuId} )
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

/* 메뉴화면통계텝 최다접근/최다사용/전체접근/버튼클릭 (selectAuditSummary) */ SELECT ( SELECT MENU_NM /*최다 접근 메뉴*/ FROM (SELECT M.MENU_NM, COUNT(*) CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID WHERE A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS "topMenu", (SELECT CNT /*최다 접근 메뉴 건수*/ FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A WHERE A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS "topMenuCount", (SELECT MENU_NM /* 최다 사용 화면*/ FROM ( SELECT M.MENU_NM, COUNT(*) CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID WHERE 1=1
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS "topScreen", (SELECT CNT /* 최다 사용 화면 건수*/ FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M WHERE 1=1
and FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY MENU_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS "topScreenCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) /* 전체 화면 접근 건수*/ FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M WHERE MENU_ID IS NOT NULL ) AS "totalAccessCount", (SELECT MENU_NM /* 버큰 클릭 최다 화면*/ FROM (SELECT M.MENU_NM, COUNT(*) CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID WHERE A.BTN_ID IS NOT NULL
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS "topButtonScreen", (SELECT CNT /* 버큰 클릭 최다 건수*/ FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A WHERE A.BTN_ID IS NOT NULL
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
GROUP BY A.MENU_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS "topButtonCount" FROM DUAL

/* 메뉴화면통계텝 상세 통계 (selectAuditDetail) */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM DESC) AS "no", NVL(P.MENU_NM,M.MENU_NM) AS "menuNm", M.MENU_NM AS "screenNm", A.BTN_ID AS "btnId", CASE WHEN A.BTN_ID IS NULL THEN '화면접근' ELSE '버튼접근' END AS "accessType", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FRST_REG_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "lastAccessDt" FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M P ON A.MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID WHERE A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and (M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} OR M.UPRN_MENU_ID = #{menuId} )
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

/* 메뉴화면통계텝 상세 통계 페이징 총카운터 (selectMenuCount) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M P ON A.MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID WHERE A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and (M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} OR M.UPRN_MENU_ID = #{menuId} )
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
/* 메뉴화면통계텝 최상위 메뉴 콤보 (selectTopMenuList) */ SELECT MENU_ID AS "menuId" ,MENU_NM AS "menuNm" FROM OCUOC_MENUN_M WHERE MENU_LEVEL = 1 ORDER BY MENU_ID

/* 메뉴화면통계텝 엑셀다운 조회 (selectAuditMenuExcel) */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM DESC) AS "no", NVL(P.MENU_NM,M.MENU_NM) AS "menuNm", M.MENU_NM AS "screenNm", A.BTN_ID AS "btnId", CASE WHEN A.BTN_ID IS NULL THEN '화면접근' ELSE '버튼접근' END AS "accessType", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FRST_REG_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "lastAccessDt" FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M P ON A.MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID WHERE A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and (M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} OR M.UPRN_MENU_ID = #{menuId} )
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM DESC

/* 부서사용자통계텝 엑셀다운 조회 (selectAuditDeptExcel) */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM DESC) AS "no", C.EMP_KOR_FLNM as userNm, B.BR_NM AS "deptNm", A.BTN_ID AS "btnId", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FRST_REG_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "lastAccessDt" FROM OCUOC_AUDIT_M A JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M M ON A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M P ON A.MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID JOIN OCUOC_USERI_M C ON A.USER_ID = C.EMPNO JOIN OCUOC_DPRMI_M B ON C.BLNG_BRCD = B.BR_CD WHERE A.MENU_ID IS NOT NULL
and (M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} OR M.UPRN_MENU_ID = #{menuId} )
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM >= replace(#{fromDate},'-','')||'000000'
and A.FRST_REG_DTTM < replace(#{toDate},'-','')||'235959'
ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DTTM DESC
